name: Upward Bound
what_you_do: Meet one on one with an advisor at your school, go to Saturday sessions, and get help with college and money forms. In summer, you can join the Summer Academy at SDSU and live in the dorms.
grades: Grades 9 to 12 (Summer Academy 2025 was for rising 10th to 12th graders)
who_can_apply: You must be from a low income family, or your parents did not finish college. You must go to one of 9 partner high schools. They are Castle Park, Mar Vista, Southwest, Crawford, Hoover, San Diego High, El Cajon Valley, Morse and Mount Miguel.
pay_detail: The program is 100% federally funded. The Summer Academy page says students get paid, but no amount is stated.
duration: School year advising plus a summer academy
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. The page links an interest form and an online application. The Summer Academy page still says to check back for 2026 registration.
how_to_apply: If you go to a partner school, fill out the interest form (in English or Spanish). You can also use the online form at the bottom of the Upward Bound page, or see the advisor at your school. Questions: 619-594-6184 or upwardboundite@sdsu.edu.
notes: In July 2025, Summer Academy students lived in the dorms. They went to talks and did a research project on a health issue in their own community. The Summer Academy page also lists paid work study jobs for rising 12th graders. It lists starter jobs for rising 11th graders too.
